description: 28th Joint Asia Pacific Regional Social Work Conference
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - 28th Joint Asia Pacific Regional Social Work Conference is scheduled to be held in Sri Lanka from 18th to 21st November 2025 and 13 local representatives and 104 foreign representatives from 30 countries are scheduled to participate in the said Conference. Accordingly, proposal made by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment to conduct the said Conference in Sri Lanka and to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the National Social Development Institute and the Sri Lanka Association of Professional Social Workers in order to establish the institutional collaboration required to conduct the said Conference, was approved by the Cabinet.
